chunks: And with this chain, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from his brother, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Surely the proud will be made in the form of small ants, and people will tread upon them until Allah finishes the accounting.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to the proud on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-Amal, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) describing the humiliating physical punishment for the arrogant, who are reduced to the size of small insects (ants) and trampled by people until the divine accounting is complete. This narration highlights the concept of 'tawazu' (humility) versus 'kibr' (pride), emphasizing that the proud will be physically diminished to reflect their spiritual inflation. The imagery of being trampled serves as a tangible manifestation of their loss of dignity in the presence of God.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 10.  It is narrated that Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) said, “Surely proud people will be reduced to the size of small ants on the Day of Judgment and people will ridicule them till Allah concludes accounting of all the people.”
